video_title: The Next Run | Summer Of Jayson

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his offseason recovery and training
quotes.excerpt: I've been to hell and back and I overcame that hurdle in my career and in my life.
quotes.quote: People always ask me how I see them. They be like, 'How was your summer?' I be like, 'Man, this shit was way better than last summer.' Last summer we spent rehabbing to get back to baseline. Going through that and having that experience, and now it's like I've been to hell and back and I overcame that hurdle in my career and in my life. So now, just knowing for a fact that I'm healthy and I'm getting back to doing what I love.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his intense summer workout regimen
quotes.excerpt: We added weight, muscle, we did boxing, track workouts. This is the time.
quotes.quote: This summer we added weight, muscle, we did boxing, track workouts. We just kind of understand this is the time. So we are going to do everything we can to maximize it.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his boxing training with Shawn Porter
quotes.excerpt: I did boxing training a long time ago when I was a kid, but that was 18 years ago.
quotes.quote: I did boxing training a long time ago when I was a kid, but that was 18 years ago. So, linking up with Shawn, I had no idea what to expect.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the mental and physical benefits of boxing
quotes.excerpt: I think I benefited a lot from a mental standpoint and obviously a cardio standpoint.
quotes.quote: I think I benefited a lot from a mental standpoint and obviously a cardio standpoint. I never even sparred with nobody, but just how tired you get throwing punches. We suck it up and we keep going, why? Because we got to do what we got to do.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his work ethic and drive
quotes.excerpt: I used to wake up every morning in high school at 5:30 and go workout before school.
quotes.quote: I used to wake up every morning in high school at 5:30 and go workout before school every single day, whether it was before season, practice day, if it was a game day, if it was the playoffs. Because I grew up in St. Louis, I used to feel like somebody on the East Coast was getting up before me and I never wanted that to be a reason why my dreams didn't come true.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his mindset during training
quotes.excerpt: When I worked out it never was a negotiation. Whatever my trainer, my coach told me to do.
quotes.quote: When I worked out it never was a negotiation. Whatever my trainer, my coach told me to do, I never crossed my mind to be like, 'Hold up.' Sometimes they are just testing you. They are just trying to see how far can they push you before you like, 'Ah, this is too much,' or you pass out.
